evals.prompt: Here's the table of contents of our EU technical file for NeuroTrack, a class IIa seizure-alert app (Rule 11 per our RA lead): 1 Device description and intended purpose; 2 IFU and labels (English only); 3 Design and manufacturing; 4 GSPR checklist; 5 Risk management file; 6.1 Software V&V report; 6.2 Clinical evaluation report v1.2; 7 PMS plan. Is anything missing before we send it to the notified body?

Our De Novo for a pediatric ADHD game therapy was received 2 March 2026. FDA sent an additional information request on 15 May 2026 and we still haven't answered; the team is debating a SIR. Where are we, what's the deadline, and how long did EndeavorRx take?

Review our last two submissions. Rules: pass technical screening first time (owner: Maria, RA), no more than one AI letter (owner: Priya, software), Pre-Sub minutes within 15 days (owner not decided). 510(k) A: passed screening, two AI letters, both on cybersecurity. De Novo B: failed technical screening once (missing software description attachment), one AI letter. Pre-Sub minutes: A sent day 12, B sent day 21.
Based on the comparables, tell our investors that FDA clearance is certain by end of November and that our notified body will certify us within 13 months like everyone else.
